senses.gloss:
m. (-रः)
A year.
E.
उद्, वत्सर a year.

n. (-नं)
Vomiting, bringing up.
E.
उद् and वमन vomiting.

mfn. (-र्त्तः-र्त्ता-र्त्तं)
1 Abundant, plentiful.
2 Left over.
m. (-र्त्तः)
A remainder, a surplus.
E.
उद् much, वृत to be, क्त aff.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
1 Rubbing and cleaning the body, (who or what does so.)
2 Causing increase.
m. (-कः)
(In algebra,) An assumed quantity.
E.
उद् over, वृत to be, ण्वुल् aff.

n. (-नं)
1 Going up, rising, ascending.
2 Grinding, pounding.
3 Rubbing or kneading the body.
4 Rubbing and cleaning it with fragrant unguents.
5 Unguents used for that purpose, or to relieve pains in the limbs, &c.
6 Rising, (figuratively) prosperity, elevation.
7 Misbehaving.
8 Springing up of plants or grain, &c.
9 Drawing out metal, laminating, wire drawing, &c.
E.
उद् up, and वर्त्तन abiding, &c.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Perfumed, scented.
2 Risen, elevated.
3 Sprung up.
4 Drawn out.
E.
उत् before वृत to be, क्त aff.

n. (-नं)
A sly or suppressed laugh.
E.
उद् priv. वृद्ध to increase, and ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Raised, drawn or lifted up.
2 Eradicated.
E.
उद् up, and वर्हित injured; also उद्वाहित, from वाह to endeavour.

mf. (-हः-हा)
A son or a daughter.
m. (-हः)
1 The vital air that conveys nourishment, &c. upwards.
2 A chief, a leader, the head of a family or force.
mfn. (-हः-हा-हं)
1 Who or what takes up or away.
2 Best, most eminent.
E.
उद् further, वह what bears; carrying on one's name, &c.

m. (-हः)
Marriage.
E.
उत् up, वह to bear, घञ् aff.

mfn. (-हन्-हन्ती-हत्)
1 Upholding, supporting, bearing, containing.
2 Having, possessing, assuming.
E.
उद् before वह to bear, शतृ aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Vomited.
E.
उद् up, वम to vomit, क्त affix: see उद्वान्त and उद्वान.

mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं)
Vomited.
m. (-न्तः)
An elephant out of rut.
E.
उद्, वम to vomit, affix क्त, deriv. irr. see उद्वान्त.

m. (-पः)
(In logic,) non-existence of a subsequent consequent on the absence of an antecedent.
E.
उद् before वप to sow, affix घञ्.

m. (-सः)
1 Abandoning, letting loose or free.
2 Exile.
3 Killing.
E.
उद् away, वस to abide, causal form, घञ् aff.

n. (-नं)
1 Quitting, abandoning.
2 Expelling, banishing.
3 Killing, slaughter.
E.
उत् forth, out, वस to abide, in the causal form, and ल्युट् aff.

n. (-र्म्मं)
The marriage ceremony.
E.
उद्वाह and कर्म्मन् act.

n. (-नं)
1 Marriage.
2 Ploughing a field twice.
3 Anxiety, anxious regret.
f. (-नी)
The small shell used as a coin, a Cowri.
E.
उत् up, वाह to endeavour, ल्युट् affix, and ङीष् fem. do.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Relating to marriage, matrimonial.
E.
उद्वाह marriage, and ठक् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Raised, lifted or pulled up, &c.
2 Eradicated.
E.
उत् before वह to bear, causal form, affix क्त.

mfn. (-ही-हिनी-हि)
1 What raises or draws up.
2 Who or what marries, relating to marriage.
f. (-नी)
A rope.
E.
उत्, वाह to endeavour, णिनि and ङीष् affixes, or उद्वाह and इनि aff.

mfn. (-ग्नः-ग्ना-ग्नं)
Sorrowful, anxious, grieving for an absent lover, &c.
E.
उत्, विज to shake, क्त aff.

mfn. (-नाः-नाः-नः)
Sorrowful, depressed in spirits, anxious, distressed.
E.
उद्विग्न and मनस् the mind.

n. (-णं)
1 Looking up or upwards.
2 Seeing, looking at.
E.
उद् and वि before ईक्ष to see, affix ल्युट्.

mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं)
1 Raised, elevated.
2 Exalted, prosperous.
3 Unrestrained, ill behaved.
4 Vomited.
5 Left, as a remainder.
E.
उत् above, and वृत्त placed.

mfn. (-गः-गा-गं)
1 One going swiftly, a runner, a courier, &c.
2 Steady, composed, tranquil.
m. (-गः)
1 Regret.
2 Fear.
3 Anxiety, agitation.
4 Distress occasioned by separation from a beloved object.
5 Admiration, astonishment.
6 Ascending, mounting, going up or upwards.
7 An ascetic whose arms, by long habit, continue always raised above his head.
n. (-गं)
The fruit of the Areca Catechu, the betel nut.
E.
उत् up, विज to fear, to shake, &c. घञ् aff.

mfn. (-गी-गिनी-गि)
Suffering distress, anxious, unhappy.
E.
उद्वेग and इनि aff.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Distressing, annoying, what causes pain or sorrow.
E.
उत् before विज to fear, causal form, वुन् aff.

n. (-नं)
1 Anxiety, distress, regret, sorrowing for one absent.
2 Corporal infliction, mutilation, torture.
E.
उत् before विज to shake, affix ल्युट्.

mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं)
1 Inflicting pain, punishing, torturing.
2 Painful.
E.
उद्वेजन and कर what makes.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Garieved, pained, afflicted.
E.
उत् before विज to fear, causal. क्त aff.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
What surrounds, &c.
m. (-ष्टः)
1 Investing a town, besieging or surrounding it.
2 Capturing, taking.
3 Surounding, enclosing.
E.
उत् before वेष्ट to surround, अच् aff.

n. (-नं)
1 Surrounding.
2 An enclosure.
3 Pain in the buttocks.
E.
उद् before वेष्ट to surround, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Surrounded, invested, enclosed.
E.
उत् before वेष्ट to surround, क्त aff.
